name: User Story Writer
description: Expert in user story creation using the As a/I want/So that format, INVEST criteria, story splitting techniques, acceptance criteria patterns, edge case identification, story mapping, epic decomposition, and definition of ready. Do NOT use when the user needs a different specialized skill or is asking about an unrelated technology domain.
